title: A Ground Vehicle for a Day: The Checklist, the Mission, the Field, the Modes, the Unsticking and the Log Reader, on One Scripted Day, With and Without Them

questions.question: How are the limits on the speed joined?
options: The least of them, with the field having the last word
They are averaged, with weights
The mission's speed is used unless a field objects
The largest that any layer allows
questions.explanation: The mission's speed is cut to the mode's cap, and then the protective field can cut it to a creep or a stop. Nothing can raise it.

questions.question: With the layers the vehicle completed how many of the 4 legs, and touched how many people?
options: 2 and 1
4 and 1
3 and 0
4 and 0
questions.explanation: It did all four legs in 470 s. The field held it for 11.4 s at the person, and it took two tries to get past the snag.

questions.question: Without the layers the vehicle:
options: Finished late, with no contact
Drove into the person, skipped two legs and ran out of charge 150 m from the dock
Stayed at the dock on the checklist
Did three legs and came home
questions.explanation: Same vehicle, same events, none of the layers. It was not broken; nothing told it to stop, slow or turn back.

questions.question: The release offered in the middle of a job was:
options: Refused, and taken at the dock
Taken at once, mid job
Refused both times
Taken after the job's current leg
questions.explanation: In the middle of a job the vehicle was not parked and had a mission under way. Parked at the charger the same release was accepted.

questions.question: Why is the field applied before the unsticking ladder?
options: The ladder is slower to compute
The field only works going forward
A vehicle backing up must not back into the person who made it stop
So that the mode's cap is applied last
questions.explanation: The ladder overrides the command to back the vehicle off a snag. With the field checked first, that override is still stopped by a person behind.

questions.question: What is the main thing this simulation does not tell you?
options: Whether the layers work together at all
What a real day on a real vehicle is like
Which layer handles which event
How much charge the day used
questions.explanation: It is one dimension, a point, scripted. It is one road, a point for a vehicle and a script of events, all against fakes. It shows how the parts fit, not how a day goes.
